map.估算家庭垃圾产生量，提供减量建议: Estimate household waste generation and get reduction advice
map.月垃圾量 = 基础量 + 食品残渣 + 包装 + 一次性用品 + 衣物；人均每日: Monthly waste = base + food scraps + packaging + disposables + clothing; per capita per day = (monthly amount × 12 / household size) / 365
map.基础量 = 人数 × 1.2 kg/人/天 × (1 + 地区修正)（城区 0、: Base = household size × 1.2 kg/person/day × (1 + regional adjustment) (urban 0, suburban −0.1, rural −0.2); food scraps = household size × (cooking factor + leftovers factor) × 30 (cooking: daily 2.5 / often 1.5 / occasionally 0.8 / rarely 0.3; leftovers: none 0 / occasionally 0.3 / a lot 0.7, in kg/person/day); packaging = takeaway orders×4×0.4 + parcels×4×0.15 kg; disposables = household size × factor × 30 (low 0.5 / medium 1.0 / high 2.0); clothing = none 0 / a little 5 / a lot 15 kg. Rated per capita per day: <0.5 very low, <1.0 fairly low, <1.5 close to average, otherwise high.
map.家庭自查：按人口与生活习惯估算月度垃圾量，并与人均 1–1.2 kg/天对照。: Household self-check: estimate monthly waste from household size and habits and compare it with the 1–1.2 kg per person per day benchmark.
map.减量规划：对比减少外卖、合并快递后包装垃圾的下降幅度。: Reduction planning: compare how much packaging waste falls after fewer takeaways and consolidated deliveries.
map.社区宣传：用不同参数演示一次性餐具与衣物消费对垃圾量的影响。: Community outreach: use different parameters to show how disposable tableware and clothing consumption affect waste volume.
map.中国人均生活垃圾约 1–1.2 kg/天。低于 1.0 显示环保良好，1.0–1: China's per-capita household waste is about 1–1.2 kg/day. Below 1.0 indicates good environmental performance, 1.0–1.5 is close to average, and above 1.5 signals a need to reduce.
map.哪几项对结果影响最大？: Which items affect the result most?
map.按系数看，一次性餐具高档为 2.0 kg/人/天、餐餐做饭为 2.5 kg/人/: By coefficient, disposable tableware at the high setting is 2.0 kg/person/day and cooking every meal is 2.5 kg/person/day, the two biggest contributors to the total; takeaways and parcels add linearly with frequency, so cutting frequency brings quick results.
